build_order.name: semantic_identity_and_totality_roots
build_order.reason: clamp01 is already referenced by material_learning_weight, so current top-level admission remains operationally incomplete without it. state_epoch is part of receiver semantic identity and must have a post-mutation successor before any stateful evaluator can be replay-safe.

build_order.name: pure_prediction_and_phasic_primitives
build_order.reason: These definitions determine delta, prediction mean/variance and phasic computation. They should be pure and independently replayable before state mutation is introduced.

build_order.name: receiver_state_transitions
build_order.reason: State mutation must be derived from already-defined pure computation and be epoch-bound. Habituation/opponent are lesionable candidates and therefore should be independently switchable rather than entangled with the core update.

build_order.name: bounded_control_projection
build_order.reason: Control readout depends on state and must remain separate from truth/effect authority. Thresholds require explicit configuration provenance rather than copied historical constants.

build_order.name: deterministic_receipt_and_provenance
build_order.reason: Receipt construction is last because it must expose already-determined before/after values and provenance; allowing it to hide unresolved calculations would create false completion evidence.

minimal_scientific_factorization.reason: This factorization permits a simpler outcome-credit/multitimescale baseline to be compared against historical NAcc-style habituation/opponent additions instead of embedding all historical mechanisms into one inseparable kernel.

critical_observations: The current stateful CallContract correctly exposes FrankRewardReceiverState and state_epoch but does not itself define the state_epoch successor.
material_learning_weight is syntactically declared but calls undeclared clamp01, so '4 explicitly declared obligations' is not equivalent to four independently executable computations.
Historical numerical constants in the Python reference are experiment candidates only; thresholds and transition rates need explicit current provenance/validation.
Receipt projection must not become the place where undefined inner semantics are silently implemented.
next_executable_sequence: Specify/test clamp01 and state_epoch transition first.
Specify pure prediction/phasic primitives with deterministic fixture replay and boundary/property tests.
Add state mutation in a transaction/epoch-aware evaluator with stale-epoch rejection.
Run baseline vs +habituation vs +opponent factorial lesion/rescue on matched trajectories.
Only after stable state transitions, construct RewardPlasticityReceipt and bind runtime component non-executably.
